name: Threads
notes: List, create, delete, brief, calls, profile (stage, client, rules, sources), Found for you, sync

features.feature: The Threads list groups open threads by client (outside clients first, then the user's company, then No client); each client folds (remembered) and its name opens the client; closed threads sit under "Closed · N"
Each thread row shows its icon, name, call count and last call day; Threads opens the last thread on its tab; with none picked "Pick a thread", with none at all "No threads yet"
"Found for you" shows its count in the list and as a badge on the Threads activity
New thread (+) opens a name box and a client choice; Enter makes the thread
A new thread can be made from a call's "+ Thread" or a calendar card: named after it, the call pinned (?)
Thread actions → Delete… asks first; Move to trash removes the thread (brief, profile, work) and leaves its calls
A thread is renamed with `echoctl project set <id> --name` (no window control) and the window shows the new name
A thread's header shows icon, name, client tag, stage tag, call count, since, last call; tabs Brief, Work (open count), Calls (count), People (count), Profile
Thread actions lists Open <client>, Claude about this thread, Sync now, Delete…
Brief shows the thread's own Markdown (or "Nothing yet…") and its 5 latest calls; Edit, ⌘S saves, Esc cancels
Calls lists each call with why it belongs (meeting series, client's people, Teams chat, subject, added by hand); Unpin for a pinned one, Take out for one a rule put in; "N taken out by hand"

Profile → Stage picks one of Lead, Proposal, Negotiation, Kickoff, Active, On hold, Wrap-up, Done, Lost, Cancelled, shows its history; a closed stage moves the thread to Closed and it takes no call started after
Profile → Client chooses, changes or clears the client, or makes a new one inline; Organisations adds an existing or new counterpart, × unlinks it
Profile → Calls adds rules (meeting series, the client's people, subject contains, Teams chat) and removes them; the count of matching, pinned and taken-out calls follows
Profile → Since, History (only with Recall on), Notes for Claude, Look (colour, own logo), AI profile and model are edited in place and saved at once
Profile → Meetings lists the thread's meeting series read only (next, calls); × says the series isn't this thread's

Profile → Sources shows meeting chats (offered from its calls), channels, mail (suggested from the client's domains) and folders with how each was read or its error; without Recall or Microsoft 365 it says what is and isn't read

Found for you lists candidate threads (a series, an organisation, a chat) with why, their calls, a client choice (none / new from the domain / existing) and Add to a thread; Accept makes it, Reject never suggests it again
Membership is computed from rules, pins, exclusions, since and closed stage — never written into a call; suggestions never assign (`project show`, `project of`)
A thread's sync (extract, verify, people) runs on its AI profile after its calls are 15 minutes old, or on Sync now, and reads them into its work
